title: Chapter 507
paragraphs: Chapter 507
Episode 140. Real and Fake
No one had expected this development.
However, Jin had planned to use Joshua this way since the escape began.
Someone had to make a sacrifice to overcome such a crisis. And among the group, the only one who could die without consequence was the cloned Joshua.
With a desperate heart, Jin wanted to save Jane as well.

However, without the legacy of Numerus, Jane was already in a state where she couldn't be revived, and she alone couldn't realistically secure any meaningful amount of time against the ten Wraith Squadron members and additional reinforcements.
A brief silence passed.
"I was going to do that even if you didn't tell me."
As Joshua replied with an indifferent voice, even Jane looked back at him, surprised.
Diphus was the most shocked.
"What? Joshua, are you serious?"
"2nd generation, we cannot survive together."
"It's rather fortunate that I can risk my life now, rather than when fighting the Tower Keeper."
"Joshua, what are you thinking?"
"It's just as you see, Diphus. I'm just making a choice for the family. If you have a complaint, why don't you step up instead of me?"
"There's no reason for me to complain. It's just that I know better than anyone that my brother is not the kind to easily put his life on the line."
It wasn't the time for a lengthy conversation.
"See you later, 2nd generation."
Whoosh!
Joshua threw the black sword Kainer, which was at his waist, to Jin. Even if the clone died, there was no need to lose the sword as well.
"I'll take it back when I return."
"I was thinking that the sword would be a waste, but what will you fight with...?"
The moment Jin spoke up to that point.
Suddenly, Joshua's eyes turned black, all the way to the whites.
- If it's still not enough, you may have to... consider using that power.
Thoughts Joshua had to himself during the battle with Hedo.
That power, which hesitated to use during the battle with Hedo, now dyed his eyes a murky black and formed a new sword in his hand.
'Joshua, what is this!?'
'What is this? It seems similar to the power of the bushes?'
'...Is it a Taki?'
The energy surrounding Joshua seemed similar to the Taki of Amela they had encountered in the Gaipa military road.
But even more intense and refined than that, Joshua's Taki had a color almost identical to that of the spirit energy.
'I expected the prophet to have a deep connection with chaos, but... Can Taki be used to enhance others like this?'
The staffs of the wraiths, lined up in formation, simultaneously emitted white magical rays. It was a concentrated attack on Joshua, who had just started to move.
And the group was once again shocked by the sight of him easily blocking or repelling all the magical rays with a protective shield.
'There's no way that's his real skill. Is this also the prophet's ability?'
Diphus narrowed his eyes.
Though Joshua was undeniably a very strong warrior, he was definitely not at the level of being called a superhuman.
Moreover, it was impossible for him to deflect the attacks of the ten wraiths so lightly while he had just been fighting and injured.
[I can't maintain this state for long. I'll hold them off as much as I can, so make sure to take the stolen items back to the family.]
Jin and Murakan, who knew he was a clone, were calm, but Diphus had mixed feelings.
He had always wished for Joshua's death, but he had never imagined it would end like this.
Of course, there was no sentimental realization that his feelings towards Joshua were not hatred, but rather affection; it was just a bit bewildering.

"Well, I don't know what you're thinking, but we better leave before you change your mind. Brother, please make your last stand as glorious as possible. After all, it's in front of the enemy. If you somehow make it back alive, I'll kill you myself."
Before leaving, Jin and Diphus placed their swords on Jane's back.
She was swinging her sword at the new magical rays shot towards the group.
Swoosh-!
Unbelievably fast and accurate swordplay for someone already on the verge of death.

Jane was burning her last will with all her might. Like a flame revealing a greater light just before going out, her sword briefly surpassed the realm she had reached throughout her life. She transcended one more step, carrying the value of duty on her back.
Next, three wraiths approached to block her. The rest seemed to be aiming for Jin and the others, who were already moving away.
[Isn't it underestimating to engage in close combat against Runcandel?]
Clang-!
Two of the falling staffs aimed at Jane were blocked by Joshua's sword. The remaining one, which transformed into a spear shape, was repelled by Jane.
[Moreover, it's the Black Knight.]
Squelch!
One of the three who rushed in didn't hear Joshua's words.
Jane's counterattack cut off his head. Although her shoulder was stabbed as she pushed herself too hard, it couldn't dampen her resolve.
Seeing their comrade's head fall, the wraiths hesitated.
No matter how skilled Jane, the Black Helmet, was with a sword, they never imagined that she could produce such a result with a single strike while her body was close to being a corpse.
The wraiths had expected that Jane wouldn't even be able to meaningfully injure the ones who charged at her, let alone cut off their heads.
'What is this? Molten died in a single strike?'
'How on earth, just standing alone is a miracle!'
'They say that those from Runcandel are particularly bothered by this kind of thing. Sometimes they manifest these inexplicable powers...'
Jane said this while looking at the Phantom Knights adjusting their distance. She forcibly realigned her shattered shoulder.
"I cannot let you pass... Zipple."
Her whole body was torn and broken, but only her eyes shone with a pale light.

The remaining nine Phantom Knights felt chills down their spines as they met her gaze. Despite still having an absolute advantage even after losing one person, they felt an indescribable sense of unease, as if their chests were tightening.
Some could stay, some could chase the escapees.

Considering the difference in strength, they could choose either option. However, the Phantom Knights were engulfed by a strong intuition that if they left only four or five of them, they would suffer irreversible damage.
'Not only the Black Knight but also Joshua Runcandel suddenly have increased strength.'
'We can't lose another member in vain like this. Squads 4, 5, 6, and the main force will arrive soon, so we will finish these two off here and resume the pursuit!'
'Surely, Sandra Zipple wouldn't help with the escape to the very end, immersed in her insane love game. Even without any proper plan, she alone couldn't provide any meaningful assistance.'
The Phantom Knights regrouped. Those who were about to chase Jin's group began drawing magic circles, fully opening their power.
"It seems you're finally getting serious, Phantoms."
[It is an honor to be part of your final battle, Lady Jane.]
Joshua stood back-to-back with her.
"…2nd generation. It seems the rumors were true."
Jane spoke of the rumor before expressing gratitude for his participation.
[Rumor?]
"That there is more than one of your bodies."
Her tone was dry, but Joshua could clearly sense the deep contempt hidden within. It was his first time seeing the Black Knight reveal her emotions to such an extent.
[...Is that wrong?]
Jane didn't answer.
[Regardless of how you think, I am realizing the highest value of the family in my own way.]
Although she wanted to serve Jin, it was not a lie that Jane followed Joshua under Rosa's orders all this time.
She believed it was the path to dedicating loyalty to the family.
However, she was also human. And now, she was facing death.
Disappointment was inevitable.
"Struggle, is that what you're talking about?"
[Yes.]
The sky was dyed red by the magic spread by the Phantom Knights.
The exclusive Phantom Knights magic circle, 'Crimson Abyss,' which Jin had first encountered when he met them, was unfolding.
Huuu...
Jane took a deep breath.
"It's so pathetic... You should be ashamed, Joshua Runcandel."
Like a blood rain, red magical particles spread from the sky, turning into swords and chains, pouring down on the two of them.
Zzzz, clank-!
Jane's first move against the Crimson Abyss was to deflect the red blade falling on Joshua's back.
Urggh!
At that sight, Joshua felt something familiar and terrifying surge in his chest.
Guilt.
A monster that had taken up residence deep within him one day and had never left since.
[What do you know... Lady, what do you know to speak so recklessly!]
Joshua screamed, cutting off the chain falling on Jane's head. His blackened eyes were shaking.
"Fortunately, at least."
[Even in the face of the harsh contempt shown by my father, sister, brothers, and sometimes even my mother, and the thousands of disappointments, I never gave up. I was more desperate than anyone!]
"My last glory is dedicated to the real one, not the fake."
Their swords crossed without a break.
Deflecting the red blades and chains falling in their squares, they appeared as if they were swinging their swords to cut each other if you didn't look closely.
[Why don't you acknowledge me...! No one, no one! No one...!]
Their near-scream was scattered in the void amidst the roar of the clash between the two swords and the magic of nine people.
How much time had passed?
In the end, Jane's flame went out.
Thump!
The blade of the Crimson Abyss pierced through her back.
She had been swinging her sword fiercely like a vengeful ghost until the last moment, but suddenly stopped moving.
Now, her physical body had reached a point where it could not be helped by any transcendent power or will that a human could possess.
[Damn it, Jane!]
Joshua reflexively reached out with his sword, but protecting her was impossible, and even if he managed to do so, it would be meaningless.
At the moment her body was about to be slaughtered by the chains and blades, Jane looked straight at Joshua one last time.
I hope my current state will serve as a lesson.
Thus, the Black Knight of Runcandel, Jane, met her end.
The remaining fake continued to fight alone in the Crimson Abyss, where her body disintegrated for a while.
